title: Owen bảo vệ Ronaldo: Thật quá dễ để đổ lỗi cho anh ấy

scenes.subjectHint: hook-1: Michael Owen (BLV) · hook-2: Cristiano Ronaldo
scenes.prompt:
hook-1: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring Michael Owen, the English former striker and football pundit, in a smart-casual TV studio pundit suit, looking serious and analytical, framed chest-up with head in the upper third. Background: a stylized dark graphic backdrop with abstract light rays. 
hook-2: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring Cristiano Ronaldo, the Portuguese striker for the Portugal national team, wearing the red-and-green Portugal home kit with the Portugal crest, in a frustrated looking-down pose, framed chest-up with head in the upper third. Background: a red-and-green Portugal graphic backdrop with a faint Portugal crest watermark and light rays. Both images stylized like a matchday broadcast graphic poster.

scenes.subjectHint: Cristiano Ronaldo — Bồ Đào Nha (Thất vọng)
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring Cristiano Ronaldo, the Portuguese striker and captain for the Portugal national team, in a frustrated pose looking up at the sky with hands on his hips after a missed chance. He wears a red-and-green Portugal home kit with the Portugal national team crest clearly visible on the chest. Background: a moody dark red graphic backdrop with a huge faded Portugal crest watermark, dramatic downward-pointing cold light rays creating a somber disappointed atmosphere. Moody saturated dark red palette, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a tournament disappointment editorial poster. The Portugal crest visible on the jersey, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.

Vertical 9:16 football poster artwork featuring Lionel Messi, the Argentine forward and captain for the Argentina national team, in a triumphant hero pose celebrating a goal, pointing both index fingers to the sky. Background: a glorious light-blue-and-white graphic backdrop with a huge stylized Argentina crest floating faintly behind him as a watermark, dramatic golden light rays radiating outward, three glowing golden star graphics representing his hat-trick faintly glowing near him. Vibrant saturated palette with gold highlights, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a historic-moment promotional poster. The Argentina crest visible on the jersey, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
